messages:
alex: quick async check-in — yesterday I finished the gateway auth middleware tests and started canarying the new auth header normalization in prod. Today I'll finish the rate-limit tuning for bursty clients. Blocker: rate-limit counters sometimes reset after autoscale, seeing spikes in 503s. pinging @maria to double-check the routing-policy merge.
maria: saw the canary logs, looks good on header normalization. i'll take a look at the routing-policy PR after standup. do you have the pr link? :+1:
alex: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/482 (auth middleware + policy updates). note in the description i added the observable for per-instance token buckets.
jin: brief note on the 503s — we saw similar when the autoscaler replaced nodes and Redis TTLs for the rate keys were short. can you paste the redis key TTLs or a snippet of logs? might be the `burst-window` is too small.
alex: snippet from last failure (copied):
```
[2026-03-16T22:14:02Z] rate_limit: key=client:123 ttl=3s count=0 -> allow
[2026-03-16T22:14:02Z] instance-terminate: evicting cache
[2026-03-16T22:14:03Z] rate_limit: key=client:123 ttl=0s count=0 -> reject 503
```
sam: cc @jin @maria — quick ask: are we comfortable with the fallback routing policy? if primary model pool is overloaded we should route to cheaper quantized variant automatically. i can add a canary config if we want to test that flow.
maria: yes, fallback to quantized variant approved by product, but let's gate it by an SLO check. sam, please add the canary and a metric-based rollback.
jin: i'll add a small integration test to simulate node replacement + rate-limit TTL expiry. will open a tiny PR later today.
ci-bot: deploy job #7623 for infra/gateway started by alex — canary rollout to 4% traffic. Watch: https://deploys.redwood/internal/7623
alex: thanks — i'll watch the canary and post updates. if anyone spots regressions please DM me. small follow-ups: (1) @maria review PR 482, (2) @sam can you add the quantized-fallback canary config, (3) @jin integration test plz. :rocket:
maria: on it, aiming to review by EOD PST.
sam: will draft canary today.
jin: PR for tests incoming in ~3h.
alex: cool, that's it from me. tz heads-up: i'll be offline after 18:30 UTC but monitoring alerts.
